Built for local-first Android finance automation with Google Sheets.

Finance Automation operates strictly local-first. All financial notifications are parsed entirely on your device. Transaction records are written directly to your private Google Sheets spreadsheet and never pass through any third-party backend servers.

The notification listener filters incoming alerts using a built-in registry of 13 verified payment apps (including Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Supermoney, Amazon Pay, CRED, Navi) and 3 system SMS packages (debit alerts accepted only from verified bank-style sender IDs). For chat apps carrying payments (WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business), only notifications specifically categorized by the system as payment channels are read; all personal messages, groups, calls, media, OTPs, and other chat apps (Telegram, Signal) are strictly rejected without reading their text.

Technical diagnostics (Crashlytics crash reports and anonymous usage counts) are strictly opt-in and disabled by default. When enabled, reports never contain transaction amounts, payees, account digits, spreadsheet IDs, or message text.

You can choose to send a technical problem report to help diagnose issues. A report is sent only when you explicitly tap Send after reviewing the exact technical payload. It contains app version, device model, Android SDK level, a random install identifier (not tied to your Google account), the active screen, diagnostics counters, and your optional typed description. It never contains transaction amounts, payees, account numbers, spreadsheet IDs, or message text. Reports are stored securely in Firebase Firestore and are read only by the developer.
We only request Google Drive and Sheets scopes necessary to read and update your designated ledger file (drive.file). The app cannot access your other Drive documents.
